about.text: Software Engineer with practical full-stack and backend experience, now focused on AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Generative AI and LLM-based applications. Knowledge includes tokenization, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, semantic search, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, AI agents, function calling, fine-tuning, evaluation, security and production deployment. PhD researcher in Information-measurement and management systems, interested in applying AI to real business problems.

bullets: Built web and mobile applications with React, Flutter, Node.js and PostgreSQL for job-search and medical-support startups.
Developed REST APIs with authentication, profile management and social-network features.
Deployed and tested backend services on Render for an environment prepared for approximately 300 test users.
Worked across programming languages, frameworks and databases to deliver practical software solutions.
Developed backend software using several programming languages and CMS technologies.
